header.description: The first half of a PCA control: harvest the residual stream at EVERY token of the training prompts — a ragged read, ~36 vectors from 4 rows, the tokenizer's own BOS not among them because it is not a token of the prompt — and reduce it to its top-4 principal directions, an orthonormal (16, 4) basis, written as a bundle a later document loads as a `pca` featurizer. Nothing is trained; the basis is what the data says. (One position per row would be 4 vectors, and four vectors have no rank-4 PCA; the compiler says so.)
